name: Combat Hit Rules
description: Within 10 studs, attacks are guaranteed to hit. Beyond 10 studs, real 3D distance including height is used. Attacks only hit targets within a ±45° forward attack cone, and large height differences cause attacks to miss. The cone was widened from ±20° in a follow-up small update on July 30, 2026.
source: Official Discord big-updates combat announcement plus small-updates follow-up dated 2026-07-30

name: Race Reroll Odds
description: Race Reroll odds were normalized to 33.33% per race in the July 28, 2026 patch.

name: Item Trade Status
description: Every item displays whether it is Bound, Tradeable, or Free, indicating whether it can be traded or given away.

name: World Loot Unlock
description: World loot unlocks after completing Working the Land.

name: Monster Elemental Attributes
description: Monsters have elemental attributes as part of the elemental combat system.

name: HP/MP Regeneration Formula
description: Total Regen = Base Regen + Bonus Regen. Bonus Regen equals 0.2% of Max HP/MP and is capped at 3% of Max HP/MP. Regeneration runs at 50% in combat, 100% out of combat, and 150% while sitting.

name: Identify System
description: Magnifying Glasses can identify Shoes, Gloves, Bracelet, Necklace, Upper Headgear, Middle Headgear, and Lower Headgear. Magnifying Glasses were introduced as Lycaros drops and, as of v1.1.10, can also drop from Junk King and Tin Tortoise.
source: Official Discord big-updates v1.1.6 and small-updates v1.1.10

name: Invalid Target Mana Cost
description: Casting a skill without a valid target consumes 50% of the skill's normal mana cost rather than the full amount.

name: Combat Mode Trigger
description: As of v1.1.12, all attacks trigger Combat Mode. Earlier v1.0.5 behavior triggered Combat Mode when dealing or receiving damage.
source: Official Discord small-updates v1.0.5 and v1.1.12

name: Part-Time Jobs
description: Part-Time Jobs can be performed with selected NPCs while they are sleeping. Confirmed NPCs: Breda, Eren, Neria, Leaf, Arlette, and Hogan.

name: Claw Machine Stuck Protection
description: As of v1.1.10, if the Claw Machine gets stuck and gives no reward, the player is guaranteed 1 Goblin Coin. Reward probabilities are displayed and the machine can be restocked. Magnifying Glass was added to the prize pool in v1.2.13.

facts: Stuck protection guarantees 1 Goblin Coin when no reward is given
Magnifying Glass added to the prize pool

source: Official Discord small-updates v1.1.10 and big-update announcement by Swaroff [PRTL], 2026-08-20

name: Server Hop Filters
description: Server Hop supports All, Friends, and Filter by Name options.

name: Title Equip Limit
description: Players can equip only one title at a time.

name: Auto Jump
description: Auto Jump is disabled as of v1.1.12.

name: Pet Collision
description: Pet collision is disabled as of v1.1.12 to prevent pets from getting in the way. Pet pathfinding toward targets was also fixed in this patch.

name: Gathering Macro Rules
description: Macros for woodcutting and mining are currently allowed. Auto-combat or auto-mob macros are prohibited and treated as rule violations.

name: Greenhouse
description: Craftable at the Workbench. Each plot normally supports 1 Greenhouse; the Season 1 Premium Pass grants one additional permanent Greenhouse slot.
source: Official Discord announcements by Swaroff [PRTL], 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-05

name: Additional Quick Slots
description: Additional Quick Slots unlock after clearing Chapter 2.

name: Skill VFX Filter
description: Graphics setting controlling whose skill effects are displayed. Options: Self, Party, Everyone.

name: World Motion
description: Graphics toggle that can reduce environmental movement for a smoother, less distracting experience.

name: Guild System
description: Guilds are created through Rendall for 499 Robux. Guilds begin with capacity for 15 members and can be upgraded to a maximum of 30. Arcane Defense is available every Friday and must be started manually by the Guild Leader. Guild activities award Guild EXP and Guild Coins, and donated decorations can be used collaboratively to build the Guild Base.

lycarosQualifiedMember.requirement: Each Guild member qualified for Lycaros rewards

guildBase.use: Donated decorations can be used to build the Guild Base together with fellow Guild members.

source: Official Discord big-update announcement and Guild reward-system announcement by Swaroff [PRTL], 2026-08-20

name: Arcane Defense Wave Rewards
description: Official Arcane Defense reward chart for waves 1–50. Every completed wave grants 300 Guild EXP, 1 Guild Coin, the listed Tria, and the listed additional reward.

name: Maximum Damage Up
description: The maximum Damage Up cap increased from 100% to 120% in v1.2.13.
source: Official Discord big-update announcement by Swaroff [PRTL], 2026-08-20
